OWD5 cloud only. Devices are created per: OWD5 cloud only. Devices are created per GroupId. Writeback uses Group/UpdateGroup. Energy uses EnergyUsage/GetEnergyUsage with ThermostatID (Thermostats[].Id).
localAllowCommandsHelp: If the thermostat is connected locally, apply.schedule and apply.manual are sent directly to it. Other modes still use the cloud.
localBetaWarning: BETA: Local control is experimental and has not been confirmed on WD5-series thermostats (OWD5/MWD5) yet. Use at your own risk and please report your observations.
localHint:
The adapter runs its own device gateway. A local DNS record must point the hostname of the vendor's device gateway to the ioBroker host, then the thermostat has to be power-cycled.
Relay: the connection is passed on to the vendor cloud (app keeps working) and everything is read locally. Local only: the thermostat is answered by ioBroker and never contacts the cloud (needs one successful relay session first).
localUpstreamHostHelp: The hostname the thermostat connects to (see the DNS log of your router / Pi-hole / AdGuard).
localUpstreamPinHelp: Empty = the first certificate seen is trusted and stored.
notifyHint: Enable notifications and select the desired providers. The adapter automatically detects running instances – no instance number required.
